thread:
sarah: quick note — onboarding demo hit a weird fncall/parsing edge. json-mode sanitizer removed object wrappers inside arrays so the schema validator failed.

matt: ugh. can you paste the raw model output and the schema you're using?

sarah: here, simplified:
```json
// model output (json-mode)
{"tool_result": [{"id":1,"value": "x"}, {"id":2,"value":"y"}]}
```
expected schema (zod):
```ts
z.object({ tool_result: z.array(z.object({ id: z.number(), value: z.string() })) })
```
observed after sdk helper sanitization:
```json
{"tool_result": ["{\"id\":1,\"value\":\"x\"}", "{\"id\":2,\"value\":\"y\"}"]}
```

jules: that looks like double-stringification. is this the js sdk or py?

sarah: js SDK (v0.9.2). py sample app works fine. getting this only when jsonMode + fnCall helper is enabled.

alex: interesting — sounds like the sanitizer tries to coerce non-objects into strings and forgets to parse array members. reproable locally?

sarah: yes. steps:
1) run sample-app with JS sdk + JSON_MODE=1
2) trigger toolcall with array-of-objects payload
3) see schema validation error in console: "expected object, received string"

matt: can you share a minimal repro branch? i'll take a look after standup.

sarah: pushed quick branch: github.com/redwood-inference/sample-apps/gh-1976-json-sanitizer (w/ test case)

eng-bot: CI test run queued for commit 3b9f... (job 4821)

jules: hypothesis — the helper's sanitizePrimitive function has an early path that stringifies unknown values, but it doesn't attempt JSON.parse on strings that look like objects when they're inside arrays. i'll open a draft PR with a fix to try parsing array members if they match ^\\{.*\\}$ or ^\\[.*\\]$.

alex: careful with heuristics — we already bit into flaky behavior when model outputs include curly braces in plain text. prefer a config flag: PRESERVE_ARRAY_OBJECTS or SANITIZE_PARSE_STRINGS with opt-in for sample apps.

matt: agreed. for now recommend a patch that only parses strings inside arrays when the original content-type header is application/json or when jsonMode=true AND user passed preserveArrayObjects true. keeps default safe.

sarah: sounds good. added note to onboarding README and linked the branch.

jules: draft PR: github.com/redwood-inference/edge-sdk/pull/422 — includes a unit test and an opt-in env var. requesting review from @matt @alex

matt: looking now. minor nit — add a test for nested arrays of mixed values (numbers + object-strings).

sarah: will update sample app to show the env var toggle in try-it section.

eng-bot: CI passed for job 4821 — all tests green :white_check_mark:

alex: LGTM, but let's add a short note in release notes: "js sdk: optional array-object parsing in jsonMode to avoid double-stringification in fncall responses".

sarah: thanks everyone — this fixes the onboarding friction. follow-up: track telemetry to see how often we hit this and if we should enable by default later.

matt: opened an issue to collect telemetry: #3052

sarah: closing the loop here. :party-parrot:
